Package com.egradx.notification.auth

Class EgradxAuthRecipientResolver

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.notification.auth.EgradxAuthRecipientResolver
All Implemented Interfaces:
EgradxRecipientResolver
public class EgradxAuthRecipientResolver extends Object implements EgradxRecipientResolver
Where to reach a user, from their egradx-auth profile: their primary verified address on the channel — one scoped to the organization first, else one that applies everywhere, else, for email only, their login email — and their language.

Two refusals, both deliberate:

  • A deactivated user is unreachable. A message to someone who has been removed should not arrive; a caller who really means to write to them can use their address directly.
  • For an organization's message, a user outside that organization is unreachable. Otherwise a caller passing the wrong id would send one tenant's message, through that tenant's provider, to a member of another. Platform-level messages (null organization) reach any user.
